headline.small: obs. № 03 · a website that sounds like you, because Monomastic listens first

note.body: P.S. — you don't need to know any of this. You just need to know your business.

hero.deck: You answer a few questions about your business over coffee. Monomastic writes the rest — the words, the structure, the Arabic if you need it. You change what doesn't sound like you. You publish.

features.title: Six things an agency used to charge two months for.

copy.title: Real copy, not lorem ipsum.
copy.body: Monomastic writes every page in your voice — your story, menu, contact note — then you edit it like a Word doc.

belongs.title: A site that belongs to you.
belongs.body: Your colors, your photos, your neighborhood. Visitors should recognize it from your Instagram.

bilingual.title: EN and AR, written together.
bilingual.body: Both languages get the same care, the same rhythm, the same headlines — not a thin translation.

edits.title: Edits that can't break it.
edits.body: Change a headline, swap a photo, add a menu item. The layout reflows. You can't mess it up.

hosted.title: Hosted at yourname.monomastic.site.
hosted.body: Fast, on a real domain, ready when your customer searches for you tonight. SSL, mobile, search basics.

keep.title: Yours to keep. Always.
keep.body: Export your content any time. If you outgrow us, you take the writing with you. No lock-in.

one.title: Tell us about your business.
one.body: A short conversation — what you sell, who comes in, what you'd want a regular to know.

two.title: Monomastic writes the site.
two.body: Every page, in both languages if you want, with your tone and your details already in place.

three.title: Tweak, then publish.
three.body: Edit the parts that don't sound like you. Hit publish. Send the link to your group chat.

langs.title: English and Arabic. One brand, one voice.

en.title: A story that feels like your business.
en.body: We’ve been serving our community from the same corner since 2014, with the same care and the same recipe that built our reputation.

ar.title: قصة تبدو مثل تجارتك.
ar.body: نخدم مجتمعنا من نفس الزاوية منذ 2014، بنفس العناية ونفس الوصفة التي بنت اسمنا.

proof.title: Built for people who'd rather be running the place.

faisal.quote: I don't know what a CMS is, and I don't need to. I changed the about page twice. It looked better both times.
faisal.name: Faisal A.

noura.quote: The Arabic came out right. Not Google Translate right. My mother-in-law read it and didn't laugh.
noura.name: Noura K.

reem.quote: My old site took three months. This one took an afternoon. Nobody can tell which is newer.
reem.name: Reem S.

final.headline: Make the site. Own it.
final.sub: It takes about ten minutes. It costs nothing to try. And it ends with a site that sounds like the person who actually runs the place.
final.assure: Free to try · No card · Content stays yours · EN · AR

footer.about: A website builder for people who didn't want to learn how to build a website. Field-tested with small businesses in the Gulf and beyond.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1_body: When you create an account we collect your email address and name. When you use the builder we store the content you add, the pages you create, and analytics about visitors to your published website.
privacy.s2_body: We use this information to run the service, save and serve your website, show you analytics, and keep the service secure. We do not sell your data.
privacy.s3_body: Your data is stored on our servers, hosted securely in the cloud. Site images are stored with a secure object-storage provider.
privacy.s4_body: We use a session cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
privacy.s5_body: Questions about this policy? Contact us at support@monomastic.example.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1_body: You may use the builder to create and publish websites for lawful purposes. You are responsible for the content you create and for keeping your account credentials safe.
terms.s2_body: You keep ownership of the content and images you add. You grant us permission to store, process, and display that content so we can run the service, including serving your published website.
terms.s3_body: Free usage is subject to the limits shown on the pricing page. Paid features open as they launch, and we will show prices before any charge.
terms.s4_body: Do not use the service to publish illegal, harmful, or deceptive content, or to abuse the service's systems.
terms.s5_body: The service is provided as is, without warranty. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damages arising from your use of the service.
terms.s6_body: We may update these terms; material changes will be announced in the app. Contact us at support@monomastic.example.
